messages:
ana: Quick sync 1 finalizing the newsletter + webinar handoff for the Benchmark report launch next Wed. Need segmentation, subject lines, and invite cadence by EOD Tue. Who picks up subject A/Bs?
liam: Ill own subject tests. two creative angles: product-first vs benchmark-first. will draft 6 short variants by tomorrow AM.
maria: Ill build segments: 1) active api users (30d), 2) trialers who used embeddings, 3) dormant (>180d), 4) partners/APAC. will include suppression lists.
devin: Webinar cadence idea: 3 touches  invite, 48h reminder, 2h last-chance. For trialers, add a pre-invite with early-access CTA?
ana: @devin im blocked Tue PM for copy review. can we lock cadence by Tue 2pm so i can review?
emily: Taking landing page + reg form. prefer minimal fields to maximize conversion; will prefill industry + team-size for routing.
liam: Draft subject lines (seed):
- `New: Redwood Benchmark + live walkthrough`
- `Where does your inference cost sit? Benchmark + webinar`
- `Cut token spend: benchmark findings + demo`
- `Benchmark highlights  live Q&A`
- `See how peers optimize inference costs`
- `Benchmark results + practical steps to save`
maria: Segment deliverables: CSV exports, timezone send windows, suppression set. dropping in #marketing-assets after lunch.
devin: Campaign cadence (for builder):
```
Day 0: Invite  1pm local (subject A/B)
Day 2: Reminder  10am local (speaker + top stat)
Day 4: Last chance  2pm local (urgent + add to calendar)
```
ana: @liam also need SMS variants for trialers  1 line + link.
liam: SMS examples: `Webinar Wed: Redwood Benchmark + live demo. RSVP: <link>` and `Quick: Benchmark highlights + 30-min demo. Save your seat: <link>`
emily: Landing mock posted  keeping form minimal, adding one short quote from the research lead. will post link in convo.
campaign-bot: Reminder set: submit final subject lines to #marketing by 2026-03-24T18:00Z.
maria: APAC asks  can we shift APAC send to 9am SGT? will create timezone buckets: APAC morning, EMEA morning, Americas afternoon.
devin: noted. will build campaign with timezone buckets and stagger sends.
ana: Action recap: 1) @liam  6 subject lines + SMS by Tue AM. 2) @maria  segments + send windows by Tue lunch. 3) @emily  landing + reg form by EOD. 4) @devin  cadence copy + campaign setup by Tue 5pm. Ill review Tue 24pm. Ops: confirm suppression list sync. :thumbsup: 
liam: on it.
maria: on it.
emily: yep.
devin: will do.
